claim: An agent perceives its environment through sensors and acts on it through actuators.
A thermostat is a very simple agent.
An agent chooses actions to achieve a goal.
PEAS stands for Performance measure, Environment, Actuators and Sensors.
For a taxi driver agent, the actuators are steering and brakes.
Chess is fully observable and deterministic.
Taxi driving is partially observable and stochastic.
The type of environment strongly affects which agent architecture works best.
A partially observable environment is one where the agent can only perceive some of the states.
A deterministic environment is one where the outcome of an action is always the same.
A static environment does not change over time.
Reinforcement learning agents learn from rewards.
A self-driving car uses LIDAR sensors.
For a taxi driver agent, the sensors are steering and brakes.
Simple reflex agents react to stimuli without considering context.
